Tuesday Night Ride (Cardinal Bicycle Grandin)

Roanoke, VA · Grandin Village · Road

Beginner friendly

Tuesday Night Ride (Cardinal Bicycle Grandin) is a road group ride in Roanoke, VA. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:45 pm from Cardinal Bicycle Grandin Village. Pace: classic 4-Crossings (advanced, regroups) or Flatlanders (beginner, no-drop).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: classic 4-Crossings (advanced, regroups) or Flatlanders (beginner, no-drop). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Ride (Cardinal Bicycle Grandin) group ride

Roanoke Outside calls it America's friendliest group ride. Two options out of the Grandin shop: the Classic 4-Crossings route with climbing and a couple of regroups, or Flatlanders on the Greenway with no rider left behind. Text RIDE to 540-625-8806 for cancellation alerts.
